## About This Site
- Name: Hanfu Dress Guide
- Description: The most complete resource for traditional Chinese Hanfu dresses. Covers styles by dynasty, how-to-wear guides, comparison articles, trusted buying recommendations, and city-specific travel guides for renting Hanfu in China.
- Audience: English-speaking readers interested in traditional Chinese clothing, Hanfu enthusiasts, travelers to China, cosplayers, and anyone curious about East Asian fashion history.
- Content type: Informational guide with practical advice, historical context, and curated buying recommendations.
